H=W=26
g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
colors={}
marks=set()
def paint(color, cells, dr=0, dc=0):
    for r,c in cells:
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        assert 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W,(color,rr,cc)
        colors[(rr,cc)]=color
def mark(cells,dr=0,dc=0):
    for r,c in cells:
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        assert 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W,(rr,cc)
        marks.add((rr,cc))
# fixed 4
paint(4,[(r,c) for r in range(13,16) for c in range(10,13)])
mark([(12,11),(13,13),(15,9),(16,12)])
# 6 moved +10,+7
p6=[(2,c) for c in range(2,7)]+[(3,2),(3,6),(4,2),(4,6),(5,6),(6,5),(6,6)]
paint(6,p6,10,7)
mark([(1,2),(1,6),(5,2),(6,4)],10,7)
# 7 moved -11,-9
p7=[(19,c) for c in range(18,23)]+[(20,18),(20,22),(21,18),(21,22)]
paint(7,p7,-11,-9)
mark([(22,18),(22,22)],-11,-9)
# 3 moved -4,+6
p3=[(20,3),(21,3),(21,6),(22,3),(22,6),(23,3),(23,6)]+[(24,c) for c in range(3,7)]
paint(3,p3,-4,6)
mark([(19,3),(20,6),(22,7),(24,7),(25,3)],-4,6)
# 9 upper piece moved +16,+3
p9a=[(1,17),(3,17),(5,17)]+[(r,c) for r in (2,4) for c in range(11,18)]
paint(9,p9a,16,3)
mark([(2,10),(4,10),(5,12),(5,15)],16,3)
# separate 9 bar moved +10,+5
paint(9,[(r,4) for r in range(12,15)],10,5)
mark([(11,4)],10,5)
# 8 moved +11,-4
p8=[(11,c) for c in (18,19,22,23)]+[(12,18),(12,23),(13,18),(13,23)]+[(14,c) for c in range(18,24)]
paint(8,p8,11,-4)
mark([(10,19),(10,22)],11,-4)
for (r,c),v in colors.items(): g[r][c]=v
for r,c in marks:
    if g[r][c]==0: g[r][c]=2
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
print('color overlap markers',sorted([p for p in marks if p in colors]))
print('component colors', {v:sum(x==v for row in g for x in row) for v in range(10)})
